favoriten.abgeschaltet: You don’t get notifications about changed favourites at the moment – the automation “Report favourite changes” decides this (Workbench → Automations). Your setting stays saved and applies again as soon as it reaches you.
laufwerk.einleitung: Connect your library in Explorer, Finder or the Files app. You browse through views, folders and tabs like directories and simply drop new post into them.
laufwerk.passwort: As the password you use an API key, not your normal password – that deliberately doesn’t work here.
laufwerk.ohneHttps: Ablago can’t be reached via https:// right now. Windows then doesn’t connect; Mac and iPhone ask. Ask your administrator to make Ablago reachable via HTTPS.
laufwerk.markiert: Selected – copy the text with Ctrl+C or ⌘+C.
laufwerk.schluessel.text: Create a separate key for each device. If a device gets lost, you delete only its key. The key may read and write so that you can file documents.
laufwerk.geraete: How it works on your device
laufwerk.windows.1: Open Explorer and click “This PC” on the left.
laufwerk.windows.2: Choose “Map network drive” at the top (in Windows 11 under “…”).
laufwerk.windows.3: Choose a free drive letter and enter the address under “Folder”: {adresse}
laufwerk.windows.4: Tick “Reconnect at sign-in” if the drive should always be there.
laufwerk.windows.5: Click “Finish”, enter the user name and the key as the password, and tick “Remember my credentials”.
laufwerk.mac.1: In Finder, choose “Go → Connect to Server …” from the menu (or ⌘+K).
laufwerk.mac.3: Choose “Registered User”, enter the user name and the key as the password; with “Remember this password in my keychain” you only need to do this once.
laufwerk.iphone.1: Under “Connect to Server” the Files app cannot do WebDAV, only SMB. For the drive you need a WebDAV app from the App Store that plugs into the Files app.
laufwerk.iphone.2: In that app, add a WebDAV connection with this address: {adresse}
laufwerk.iphone.3: Enter your e-mail address as the user name and the key as the password. The drive then appears in the Files app under “Locations”.
laufwerk.iphone.4: Just filing post works on your home network without an extra app: via SMB to your folder in the NAS intake folder (eingang/<your e-mail address>/). “Share → Save to Files” files it there straight as post – ask your administrator for the share.
export.bereit: Ready until {datum}. It is deleted after downloading.
dokpw.keine-verwaltung: This isn’t a password manager. Ablago uses these passwords only to open protected documents that you file. For your logins to websites and apps, please use a password manager.
dokpw.vertretung: Passwords for documents belong only to this person and aren’t visible when someone stands in.
dokpw.leer: None yet. When unlocking a protected PDF you can store the password here with “Remember for other documents”.
dokpw.name: Name
dokpw.loeschen.text: Documents already unlocked stay unlocked. New post with this password then has to be unlocked by hand again.
dokpw.bestaetigen.text: To view and change, please confirm with your Ablago password. The confirmation applies for 5 minutes.
dokpw.bestaetigen.mit-code: To view and change, please confirm with your Ablago password or a code from the authenticator app. The confirmation applies for 5 minutes.
rechte.verwaltungsmodus: In administration mode you see and may do everything – permissions don’t apply then. End the mode, and you’ll see here what you may do day to day.
abwesenheit.solange-abwesend-gehen-neue: While {wert} {wert2} absent, new tasks – assigned by hand, mentions and “doesn’t fit” – go to the stand-in. They get a notice about it under “To do”. With a period it applies only from–to (both inclusive) and then ends by itself; without a date, until you switch it off.
abwesenheit.du-hast-offene-aufgaben_one: You have one open task. New tasks go to the stand-in – existing ones stay with you until you hand them over.
abwesenheit.du-hast-offene-aufgaben_othe: You have {anzahl} open tasks. New tasks go to the stand-in – existing ones stay with you until you hand them over.
abwesenheit.zu-erledigen-mehrere-aufgabe: To do → Hand over several tasks
abwesenheit.einzelne-aufgaben-oder-grupp: You hand over individual tasks or groups under {link}.
apidoku.adresse-beschreibung-als-datei: Address: {span} · Description as a file: {link} (OpenAPI {openapi}) – can be imported into Postman or Bruno, for example.
apischluessel.damit-greifen-andere-progr: Other programs use this to access Ablago – with at most your permissions. Header: {span}. {link}
apischluessel.auch-fuer-das-benutzername: Also for the {link}: the user name is your email address, the password is the key. {hilfe}
apischluessel.darf-mit-passwoerter-anzei: May read password fields in plain text with ?passwoerter=anzeigen
apischluessel.programme-die-ihn-nutzen: Programs that use it can then no longer get in.
apischluessel.name: Name
apischluessel.mit-liefert-die-api: With {span} the API returns password fields in plain text. Every retrieval is recorded in the log. Only switch on if the program really needs the passwords.
apischluessel.kopiere-ihn-jetzt-er: {b} Copy it now – it is shown in full only this once.
fehlermelden.ist-kein-png-jpeg: “{name}” isn’t a PNG, JPEG or WebP.
fehlermelden.kopieren-ging-nicht-bitte: Copying didn’t work – please select the details below and copy them.
fehlermelden.sie-melden-sich-bei: {b} They’ll get in touch if they have questions.
fehlermelden.beschreibe-kurz-was-passier: Briefly describe what happened and what you would have expected. The technical details below help to reproduce it. Passwords, folder contents and documents are not included.
fehlermelden.z-b-beim-speichern: e.g. When saving an invoice, “Error 500” appeared after I had added a document.
fehlermelden.bis-zu-zwei-png: up to two, PNG/JPEG/WebP, each at most 10 MB – also by pasting (Ctrl+V) into the text field
meinexport.der-persoenliche-export-ist: Your administrator hasn't switched on the personal export. You can ask them for information about your data.
meinexport.alle-mappen-die-du: All folders you may read, with their documents, plus your tasks, reminders, favourites and your profile – in open formats (CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF), readable without Ablago. The export is not encrypted.
meinexport.als-passwoerter-csv-fuer: as passwoerter.csv for a password manager
meinexport.passwortfelder-die-ich-sehen: Include password fields I may see in plain text
meinexport.mir-ist-klar-die: I understand: the passwords are unencrypted in the file.
profil.was-du-je-mappentyp: What you may do per folder type. “Depends on the folder” means it depends on the folder, for example on whether you are responsible or have a task for it.
profil.e-mail-adresse-geaendert: Email address changed. The previous address has been notified.
profil.die-beiden-neuen-passwoerter: The two new passwords don’t match.
profil.passwort-geaendert-alle-anderen: Password changed. All other sign-ins were ended.
profil.name: Name
profil.so-erscheinst-du-bei: This is how you appear under “created by”
profil.und-bekommst-links-zum: and get links for resetting your password
profil.was-du-loeschst-bleibt: What you delete stays in the library’s bin for {wert} before it is permanently deleted.
profil.deine-geloeschten-mappen-werden: Your deleted folders are permanently deleted when you sign out.
profil.gilt-fuer-dein-konto: Applies to your account on all devices and takes effect immediately.
profil.die-startseite-der-ablage: The library’s start page shows to do, new post, the next date, a tile of your choice and the most recently opened folders.
profil.aus-nach-der-anmeldung: Off: after signing in you go straight to “To do”.
profil.mit-einem-punkt-vor: With a dot in front of the title until you open the folder – like “unread” in an email program.
profil.geaenderte-favoriten-und-eigene: Highlight changed favourites and your own folders in lists
profil.die-breite-der-bereiche: This device remembers the width of the areas in the library and Workbench and collapsed areas for you. In case something can’t be found any more:
profil.zeigt-unten-rechts-bei: Shows at the bottom right, on every page load, how long the individual steps took: network, preparation on the server, database accesses, transfer, evaluation and rendering in the browser. Applies only to you.
profil.mappen-mit-offenen-aufgaben: Folders with open tasks for you are listed under “To do”. In addition, Ablago sends the {b} by email – at your time and on your weekdays, as long as you have open tasks and aren’t absent.
profil.was-dir-wichtig-ist: What matters to you gets a star. If someone else changes one of your favourites, you get {b} “Changed” notification under “To do” – it only counts up further changes until you open the folder. You mute individual favourites in the favourites list.
profil.bei-aenderungen-an-meinen: Notify me about changes to my favourites
profil.gilt-nur-fuer-das: Applies only to the device you’re using right now – on your smartphone you can choose a different one than on the PC.
profil.ueberall-wo-du-gerade: Everywhere you are currently signed in. If you don’t recognise a device or have lost one, sign it out here – and preferably change your password.
profil.auf-allen-anderen-geraeten_one: Sign out on the other device?
profil.auf-allen-anderen-geraeten_other: Sign out on all {anzahl} other devices?
profil.geraet-abmelden.text: Whoever is working there has to sign in again.
zusammenfassung.taegliche-zusammenfassun: Daily summary of my tasks by email
zusammenfassung.kein-wochentag-gewaehlt-: No weekday chosen – the summary then never comes.
zusammenfassung.dafuer-muss-in-der: For this, the federal state must be chosen in the Workbench.
zusammenfassung.der-e-mail-versand: Email sending or the automation “Daily summary” is not set up or switched off at the moment; your setting applies as soon as both are running.
zweifaktor.bewahre-diese-codes-sicher: Keep these codes safe – separately from your phone. Without your phone you can only get back in with one of them. Each code works once. They are only shown now.
zweifaktor.1-oeffne-eine-authenticator: 1. Open an authenticator app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, Bitwarden or your device’s password manager) and scan the code.
zweifaktor.qr-code-fuer-die: QR code for the authenticator app
zweifaktor.scannen-geht-nicht-gib: Scanning doesn’t work? Enter this key by hand:
zweifaktor.2-sechsstelligen-code-aus: 2. Enter the six-digit code from the app
zweifaktor.neben-dem-passwort-fragt: In addition to the password, Ablago asks for a code from an app on your phone when you sign in. Anyone who only knows your password then can’t get in.
zweifaktor.nur-noch-wiederherstellungsco: Only {codesUebrig} recovery codes left. Create new ones.
zweifaktor.die-bisherigen-codes-gelten: The previous codes then no longer work.
zweifaktor.danach-reicht-wieder-das: Afterwards the password alone is enough again.
zweifaktor.fuer-dich-ist-die: Two-factor sign-in is required for you. A passkey fulfils it as well – with a passkey you can switch off the code app. New phone? Whoever administers Ablago can reset it; then you set it up again.
sprache.wahl: Ablago shows you the interface, messages and emails in this language.
sprache.weg: Your language “{sprache}” is no longer available in this library. You now see Ablago in the library’s language ({ablage}).
uebersetzen.anbieten: Offer “Show translation” on fields, notes and full texts
uebersetzen.lokal: Translation uses “{paket}” on your library’s device – the text doesn’t leave it.
uebersetzen.netz: Translation uses “{paket}”: the text is sent to {ziele} for this.
passkeys.text: With a passkey you sign in without a password – with your fingerprint, face or the PIN of your phone or computer. A passkey only works for Ablago; a fake site cannot use it.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.name.hinweis: So you recognise it later, e.g. “Phone” or “Laptop”.
passkeys.ablauf: Your device will ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN in a moment. With a security key, plug it in and touch it.
passkeys.hinzugefuegt: “{name}” has been added. Next time, tap “Sign in with a passkey” on the sign-in page.
passkeys.passt-nicht: Created for {alt}. Ablago can now be reached at {neu} – this passkey no longer fits there. Add a new one and remove this one.
passkeys.passt-nicht.https: Created for {alt}. Passkeys do not work at this address (without HTTPS).
passkeys.entfernen.text: You can no longer sign in with this passkey afterwards. It stays stored on the device itself – you can delete it there in the settings.
passkeys.pflicht: A passkey is required for you. You can only remove the last one after adding a new one.
passkeys.verloren: Lost a device? Sign in with your password and remove the passkey here. If you cannot get in at all, someone who administers Ablago can reset it.
passkeys.pflicht.zweifaktor: Two-factor sign-in is required for you, and without a code app your passkey fulfils it. You can only remove the last one after adding a new one or setting up the code app.
zweifaktor.passkey-erfuellt: Two-factor sign-in is required for your role – your passkey already fulfils it. The code app is possible in addition.
